C0491.title: Wu and Li Convicted for Bypassing Security Measures to Scrape Data
C0491.summary: Between 2019 and 2020, Wu and Li bypassed security protections on Beijing 58 Information Technology's website to scrape property listings and user phone numbers. They sold the data through Chongqing Hezhi Network Technology, earning over 1 million yuan in illegal proceeds before being apprehended on June 3, 2021.

references.title: Cracking security measures, scraping data, profiting over 1 million: two sentenced to five years and four years eight months respectively...
